title: 阿狸·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 狐耳搭配颊侧胡须纹，九条雪白狐尾展开清晰的扇形轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ahri is an adult fox vastaya woman with long dark hair, amber eyes, upright dark fox ears, three subtle whisker marks on each cheek, and nine distinct white tails. Preserve her poised feminine face and natural heroic comic proportions. Dress her in a fully covering red-and-ivory long-sleeved travel tunic, opaque trousers, fitted boots, and restrained ornamental trim.
art_direction.scene: Full-figure Ahri occupies ONLY the narrow central 25 percent of the square, standing upright with both feet together on a tiny rock. Her NINE white tails are the main large graphic shape, an OPEN FAN with no overlap between tips. Place FIVE distinct long tails on the LEFT, with five separate tips at approximately 11, 10, 9, 8 and 7 oclock. Place FOUR distinct long tails on the RIGHT, with four separate tips at approximately 1, 2, 3 and 4 oclock. The uppermost RIGHT tail is mandatory and rises well above her right shoulder; the other three step down to the right. All nine tails originate behind her lower back. Keep every tail individually countable with wide white-paper gaps. Her face has fox ears and cheek whisker marks. Hair remains close to her shoulders, leaving tail tips clear. Both hands gently hold ONE SMALL steady blue orb near her WAIST, entirely inside her body silhouette, leaving BOTH upper sides free for the tail fan. Full vermilion and ivory tunic, opaque trousers and boots. Cyan pencil reflections on ivory tails and warm sunlight. No separate fox animal, no additional creature, no background forms resembling tails.
art_direction.palette: ivory tails, ink black, vermilion, amber and clear sky blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
